dict.string: Voice Chatbot uses the microphone during conversations and transcription sessions you start.
Voice Chatbot uses Apple on-device speech recognition only to detect the wake phrase you configure.
Voice Chatbot uses the camera only when you choose to take a photo for your PC model to examine.
Voice Chatbot adds generated images to Photos only when you tap Save to Photos.
Voice Chatbot connects to your VoiceChatbot server on your PC over Wi-Fi or VPN.
Voice Chatbot uses calendar access to show upcoming events and add events only after you confirm them.
Voice Chatbot uses contacts to resolve names and prepare text messages only after you request them.
Voice Chatbot reads only the Apple Health categories you choose so it can answer your health and activity questions.
